entry.name: AWS Certified AI Practitioner
entry.audience: Anyone demonstrating AI literacy on AWS

reading.summary: This certification confirms foundational understanding of artificial intelligence, machine learning, and generative AI concepts and use cases on AWS. It is intended as an entry point for people exploring AI and ML on AWS. Earning it demonstrates broad basic knowledge of AI, ML, generative AI, and AWS AI services.
reading.audience: The page says it is for individuals who are familiar with AI and ML technologies on AWS and use them, but do not necessarily build AI or ML solutions. It suits people exploring AI and ML on AWS, whether adding AI skills to an existing cloud career or starting to work with AI and ML technologies.
reading.validity: Valid for 3 years. To recertify, pass the latest version of this exam or earn the AWS Certified Machine Learning Engineer - Associate, which automatically recertifies this certification.
reading.prerequisites: No required prerequisites are listed. The page says holders of AWS Certified Cloud Practitioner or an Associate-level AWS Certification can skip foundational cloud courses and start with free AI foundational training in the Exam Prep Plans.

same_level.name: Microsoft Azure AI Fundamentals (exam AI-901)
same_level.note: Foundational Microsoft credential. The required exam is now AI-901, and Microsoft states the English version was updated on April 15, 2026 and expects knowledge of Python syntax

same_provider.name: AWS Certified Machine Learning - Specialty
same_provider.note: Retired by AWS. The last day to take the exam was March 31, 2026; AWS states that holders keep an active certification for 3 years from the date it was earned. AWS now points candidates to the Machine Learning Engineer Associate

same_provider.name: AWS Certified Machine Learning Engineer - Associate
same_provider.note: The AWS machine learning credential still on offer after the Machine Learning Specialty was retired in March 2026
